OVERVIEW.SPEND_HINT: Paid orders among those shown, per currency

ORDER_SEARCH.RATE_LIMITED: Too many searches. Try again in {seconds} s.

ERRORS.STORE_UNAVAILABLE: The store is not reachable right now.
ERRORS.AUTH_INVALID: The store rejected {installationName}'s credentials. An administrator needs to reconnect the store.
ERRORS.PERMISSION_DENIED: The store refused access to its orders or customers. An administrator needs to check the store's permissions.
ERRORS.RATE_LIMITED: The store is limiting requests. Try again in a moment.
ERRORS.TIMEOUT: The store took too long to answer.
ERRORS.INVALID_RESPONSE: The store sent a response {installationName} could not read.
ERRORS.NOT_FOUND: This link request expired. Search again.
ERRORS.INVALID_STORE_URL: This store URL can't be used.
ERRORS.INVALID_QUERY: Enter an exact email, or a phone number starting with + and the country code.
ERRORS.ENCRYPTION_NOT_CONFIGURED: Store credentials can't be saved: encryption is not configured on this installation.
ERRORS.PROVIDER_DISABLED: This store platform is turned off on this installation.
ERRORS.PROTECTED_DATA_NOT_APPROVED: Shopify has not approved {installationName} to read this store's customer data (email and phone) yet, so customers can't be matched.
ERRORS.LEGACY_SHOPIFY_CONNECTED: This Shopify store is already connected through this account's Shopify integration. Disconnect it there first, then connect it here.
ERRORS.ACTIONS_DISABLED: Order actions are off for this store.
ERRORS.ACTION_UNAVAILABLE: This action isn’t possible for the order right now.
ERRORS.ACTION_IN_PROGRESS: Another action on this order is still being processed.
ERRORS.ORDER_CHANGED: The order changed in the store after you opened it. Nothing was sent. Review it again.
ERRORS.INVALID_AMOUNT: The amount isn’t valid for this order. Nothing was sent.
ERRORS.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This confirmation was already used. Start again.
ERRORS.WRITE_ACCESS_DENIED: The store’s credentials can’t change orders. An administrator can replace them.
ERRORS.NOT_APPLIED: The store shows the change wasn’t made. You can try again.
ERRORS.REFUND_DECLINED: The payment gateway refused the refund. No money was sent.
ERRORS.UNKNOWN_OUTCOME: The store didn’t answer in time. {installationName} is checking the order with the store.
ERRORS.RECOVERY_DISABLED: Abandoned carts are off for this store.
ERRORS.RECOVERY_COOLDOWN: A recovery message for this cart was sent recently.
ERRORS.CANNOT_REPLY: This conversation can’t receive a free-form message now (the customer last wrote more than 24 hours ago). Nothing was prepared: reach the customer with an approved template instead.
ERRORS.INVALID_RECOVERY_URL: The store’s recovery link isn’t safe to send. Nothing was prepared.
ERRORS.CART_NOT_ABANDONED: This cart was completed or has expired. Nothing was prepared.
ERRORS.NOT_SENT: {installationName} didn’t send this action to the store. Nothing changed; you can try again.
ERRORS.STORE_LIMIT_REACHED: You’ve connected all the stores your plan allows. Upgrade your plan or disconnect a store to connect another.

URL_ERRORS.INVALID: Enter the store address, for example https://shop.example.com.
URL_ERRORS.IP_ADDRESS_NOT_ALLOWED: Use the store's domain name, not an IP address.
URL_ERRORS.PRIVATE_ADDRESS: This address points to a private network and can't be used.
URL_ERRORS.REDIRECT: The store redirected to another address. Enter the final store URL.
URL_ERRORS.SHOPIFY_DOMAIN: Enter the store's myshopify.com domain, like your-store.myshopify.com.

SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Connect your stores so agents see a customer's orders next to the conversation. {installationName} changes an order only after an administrator turns order actions on for that store and someone confirms the action.

REALTIME.READ_ONLY_KEY: Live order updates off: this key is read-only. Replace it with a Read/Write key to turn them on.

FORM.TITLE: Add a WooCommerce store
FORM.NAME: Display name (optional)
FORM.KEYS_HINT: Keys are encrypted and never shown again.
FORM.DESCRIPTION: {installationName} connects with a WooCommerce REST API key. Choose what {installationName} may do, then create a key with that permission.
FORM.ACCESS: What should {installationName} be able to do?
FORM.ACCESS_READ_HINT: Agents see each customer’s orders in conversations.
FORM.ACCESS_READ_WRITE_HINT: Also live order updates, and order actions once you turn them on. {installationName} only adds its own webhooks; refunds and cancellations stay with administrators.
FORM.STEP_1: Open WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API and click “Add key”.
FORM.STEP_2: Choose an administrator as the user and set Permissions to “{permission}”.
FORM.STEP_3: Generate the key, then paste the Consumer key and Consumer secret below.

PICKER.TITLE: Add a store
PICKER.DESCRIPTION: Choose the platform your store runs on. Each platform connects in its own way.
PICKER.WOOCOMMERCE_HINT: Connect with a REST API key from your WordPress admin: Read to see orders, Read/Write for live updates and order actions.
PICKER.SALLA_HINT: Install the {installationName} app from the Salla App Store. No keys to copy.
PICKER.ZID_HINT: Authorize the {installationName} app on Zid. No keys to copy.
PICKER.SHOPIFY_HINT: Authorize the {installationName} Commerce app on your Shopify store. No keys to copy.
PICKER.UNAVAILABLE_NOTE: Platforms marked “Not available yet” aren’t offered on this workspace yet.

SALLA.TITLE: Connect with Salla
SALLA.DESCRIPTION: {installationName} only reads customers, orders and shipments. You never enter or see a Salla token here.
SALLA.STEP_SETTINGS: In your Salla dashboard, open the {installationName} app's settings, paste the code and save.

STATUS.WAITING: Waiting for the code from Salla…
STATUS.CLAIMED: Code received. Waiting for Salla to authorize the app…
STATUS.CONFLICT: This Salla store is connected to another {installationName} account. Disconnect it there first.
STATUS.EXPIRED: This code expired. Create a new one.
STATUS.LIMIT_REACHED: Your plan’s store limit is reached, so this Salla store wasn’t connected. Upgrade your plan or disconnect a store, then create a new code.

SALLA.REAUTH_HINT: Salla needs to authorize the {installationName} app again: update or reinstall it from your Salla dashboard. The store reconnects on its own.
SALLA.PROVIDER_OFF: Salla is turned off on this installation. The store is kept but not read.

ZID.TITLE: Connect with Zid
ZID.DESCRIPTION: {installationName} only reads customers, orders and shipments. You never enter or see a Zid token here.
ZID.STEPS: You will sign in to Zid and approve the {installationName} app for your store, then come back here.
ZID.REAUTH_HINT: Zid needs you to authorize the {installationName} app again. Use Reconnect.
ZID.PROVIDER_OFF: Zid is turned off on this installation. The store is kept but not read.
ZID.DISCONNECT_DESCRIPTION: The store's access, its webhooks and every customer link of this store are deleted. Nothing changes in the store. You can connect it again with Zid.

SHOPIFY.TITLE: Connect with Shopify
SHOPIFY.DESCRIPTION: {installationName} only reads customers, orders and fulfillments. You never enter or see a Shopify token here.
SHOPIFY.SHOP_HINT: Find it in Shopify admin → Settings → Domains.
SHOPIFY.STEPS: You will sign in to Shopify and approve the {installationName} Commerce app for this store, then come back here.
SHOPIFY.REAUTH_HINT: Shopify needs you to authorize the {installationName} Commerce app again. Use Reconnect.
SHOPIFY.PROVIDER_OFF: Shopify is turned off on this installation. The store is kept but not read.
SHOPIFY.DISCONNECT_DESCRIPTION: The store's access and every customer link of this store are deleted. Nothing changes in Shopify: to remove the app from the store, uninstall it in Shopify admin. You can connect it again with Shopify.
SHOPIFY.ACTIONS_TITLE: Reconnect Shopify to enable order actions
SHOPIFY.ACTIONS_DESCRIPTION: Shopify will ask you to give the {installationName} Commerce app write access to orders, for cancellations and refunds. Until you approve it, the store stays read-only and keeps working.

DISCONNECT_CONFIRM.TITLE: Disconnect {name}?
DISCONNECT_CONFIRM.DESCRIPTION: The store's credentials and every customer link of this store are deleted. Nothing changes in the store.
DISCONNECT_CONFIRM.DESCRIPTION_APP: The store's access and every customer link of this store are deleted. Nothing changes in the store. To connect it again, reinstall the {installationName} app in Salla and enter a new code.

CAPABILITIES.ORDER_ACTIONS_READ_ONLY_KEY: Order actions require a Read/Write {provider} API key.
CAPABILITIES.ORDER_ACTIONS_MISSING_SCOPE: Additional {provider} permissions are required. Reconnect {provider} to enable order actions.
CAPABILITIES.ORDER_ACTIONS_SWITCHED_OFF: Order actions are switched off on this installation.
CAPABILITIES.ORDER_ACTIONS_HINT: Refunds and cancellations stay limited to administrators.

CART_QUEUE.TITLE: Abandoned carts
CART_QUEUE.DESCRIPTION: Recent abandoned carts of your stores, carts of linked contacts first. Prepare a recovery message from the contact’s conversation: nothing is sent automatically.

PLAN.LIMIT_REACHED: You’ve reached your plan’s store limit ({limit}). To add another store, upgrade your plan or disconnect one.

ACTIONS.RATE_LIMITED: Too many actions were requested on this order. Try again in {seconds} s.
ACTIONS.TITLE: Order #{number}
ACTIONS.LOADING: Reading the order from the store…
ACTIONS.NONE: No action is possible on this order right now.

UNAVAILABLE.PERMISSION_DENIED: You don’t have permission for this.
UNAVAILABLE.ACTION_IN_PROGRESS: Another action on this order is still being processed.
UNAVAILABLE.PAID_REFUND_FIRST: The order is paid: refund it first.
UNAVAILABLE.ORDER_STATE: Not possible in the order’s current status.
UNAVAILABLE.NO_EMAIL: The order has no email address.

FORM.INVALID_AMOUNT: Enter an amount above 0 and up to {amount}.

CONSEQUENCES.REFUND_GATEWAY: {amount} will be sent back to the customer through {gateway}. This can’t be undone.
CONSEQUENCES.REFUND_GATEWAY_UNNAMED: {amount} will be sent back to the customer through the order’s payment method. This can’t be undone.
CONSEQUENCES.REFUND_MANUAL: The store will record a refund of {amount}. No money is sent to the customer: refund the payment yourself.
CONSEQUENCES.CANCEL: The order will be cancelled and its items returned to stock. Cancelling does not refund any payment.
CONSEQUENCES.CANCEL_NO_RESTOCK: The order will be cancelled. Cancelling does not refund any payment.
CONSEQUENCES.STATUS: The order’s status changes from {from} to {to}. The store may email the customer about it.
CONSEQUENCES.RESEND_INVOICE: The store emails its order details to the order’s billing email.
CONSEQUENCES.RESEND_PAYMENT_LINK: The store emails the order details, with its payment link, to the order’s billing email.

RESULT.SUCCEEDED: Done. The order shown is now read from the store.
RESULT.FAILED: The store didn’t make this change.
RESULT.UNKNOWN: The store didn’t answer in time. {installationName} is checking the order with the store: don’t try again until it does.
RESULT.UNRESOLVED: {installationName} couldn’t confirm the result with the store. Check the order in the store before trying again.
RESULT.STILL_PROCESSING: Still being processed. The order will update when the store answers.
RESULT.EARLIER_UNRESOLVED: An earlier action on this order couldn’t be confirmed. Check the order in the store before continuing.

CARTS.TITLE: Abandoned carts
CARTS.PREPARED: Recovery message added to the reply box. Review it and send it yourself.
CARTS.PREPARED_AT: Recovery message prepared {time}, not sent yet
